info.title: HSG navigation menu fragment
info.description: Single route serving the site's primary navigation as a bare, context-independent HTML fragment (no <html>/<pb-page> wrapper, and no usa-header wrapper either: the stable wrapper stays in every cached page body, rendered by templates/menu.html), driven by config.json `menu.items`. Exists so production nginx can edge-compose the menu into aggressively-cached page bodies via an SSI `<!--#include virtual=".../menu" -->` and cache this fragment under its own key: a menu change refreshes the nav site-wide by purging only /menu, leaving page bodies cached. The fragment omits the document Download submenu, editor Admin submenu, and login/language so it stays identical on every page. See OP#1284 and doc/nginx-ssi-menu.conf.

tags.name: menu
tags.description: Site primary-navigation fragment for nginx SSI edge-composition.

get.summary: Primary navigation as a cacheable HTML fragment
get.description: Renders templates/menu-fragment.html with the shared config context. Response carries Cache-Control: public with a long max-age ($menuapi:max-age in menu-api.xql); when proxy-caching is enabled a Last-Modified header (keyed on the fragment template's mtime) is added and If-Modified-Since is honoured with a 304. Intended to be fetched by nginx as an SSI subrequest and cached independently of page bodies. Served as application/xml (roaster's xml output method): a bare fragment with no DOCTYPE, which text/html (the html5 method) would prepend and which is invalid spliced mid-page by SSI.

get.summary: Primary navigation as the mobile menubar fragment
get.description: Same primary navigation as /menu, rendered as the collapsible mobile menubar (Pico <details> dropdowns) from templates/menu-mobile-fragment.html. Same caching contract as /menu so the mobile nav is edge-composed via SSI and refreshed independently of page bodies.
